text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wait... The new Kyumaru plushie is sold 
out!? Even at this store!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh, this is already the fifth store... If 
it's not here either, then—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
............ Ahh, Kyu-maru... And here I 
even cleared out a spot on the shelf just 
for you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite spending her precious day off 
running all around, she couldn't find what 
she was looking for, and Almond Eye was 
left thoroughly disappointed...
